notes: THE OWNER: "its almost never a good idea to invent a new programming language… I would suggest we go with Smalltalk" — and the corollary that makes it checkable: "With Smalltalk as your target its deterministic whether the language is fully implemented or not." server/st-parser.js + server/st-interp.js: a DECLARED Smalltalk-80 subset where everything included behaves as Smalltalk-80 defines it and everything excluded REFUSES BY NAME. Full message syntax (unary > binary > keyword, left-to-right binary, cascades to the receiver of the last message), blocks as full closures with NON-LOCAL RETURN
